experiment: YOLO-Master Issue #54 corrected sequence-aware MoT audit

post_merge_validation.purpose: Verify that saved checkpoints still load and preserve model ranking after merging current upstream/main.

benchmark.flops_method: torch profiler on the same deterministic input

routing_audit.significance_rule: BH-FDR q <= 0.05 and bootstrap CI excludes zero
routing_audit.paired_cluster_method: within-sequence mean, paired bootstrap, paired sign-flip permutation
routing_audit.occlusion_pairing: one lower/higher-occlusion image pair per video sequence, balanced on log object count and log median box area

notes: The original image-level reports are retained as an audit trail, but sequence-aware reports are the primary result.
Brain-tumor images are used only for out-of-distribution routing analysis, not medical detection evaluation.
Model weights, raw images, private mitochondrial data and local absolute paths are excluded.
